top demo/tb_inv.shbench for Ngspice
== analogLib/nmos4.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  provenance "virtuoso analogLib/nmos4"
  vibox -22 -32 25 32
  vsym cb86c36be852280f

pin D inout 20 -30
  vplabel none
pin G in -20 0
  vplabel none
pin S inout 20 30
  vplabel none
pin B inout 20 0
  vplabel 4 0 R0 centerLeft stick 6000

param model ""
  kind string
  doc "Model name"
param w 1u
  unit m
  doc Width
param l 180n
  unit m
  doc Length
param m 1
  doc Multiplier

impl spice spice
  format spice "M{name} {D} {G} {S} {B} {model} w={w} l={l} m={m}"
  format spectre "{name} ({D} {G} {S} {B}) {model} w={w} l={l} m={m}"
  format cdl "M{name} {D} {G} {S} {B} {model} m={m} L={l} W={w}"

line -20 0 0 0
line 0 -15 0 15
line 5 -15 5 15

poly 5 -15 20 -15 20 -30
poly 5 15 20 15 20 30

line 5 0 20 0

stext 25 8 R0 w={w}
  size 0.6
  vlabel annotate drawing lowerLeft stick IL cdsParam(1) w={w}
stext 25 -8 R0 {name}
  size 0.6
  vlabel annotate drawing7 lowerLeft stick IL cdsName() {name}

== analogLib/vdc.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  provenance "virtuoso analogLib/vdc"
  vibox none
  vsym 4069f7c95ac16f3c

pin PLUS inout 0 -30
  vplabel none
pin MINUS inout 0 30
  vplabel none

param vdc ""
  kind string
  unit V
  doc "DC voltage"
param acm 0
  unit V
  doc "AC magnitude"
param acp 0
  unit deg
  doc "AC phase"
param srcType dc
  kind string
  doc "Source type"

impl spice spice
  format spice "V{name} {PLUS} {MINUS} dc {vdc} ac {acm} {acp}"
  format spectre "{name} ({PLUS} {MINUS}) vsource{vdc != \"\" ? \" dc=\" + vdc : \"\"} mag={acm} phase={acp}{srcType != \"\" ? \" type=\" + srcType : \"\"}"

circle 0 0 15

line 0 -30 0 -15
line 0 15 0 30

stext 18 0 R0 vdc={vdc}
  size 0.6
  vlabel annotate drawing lowerLeft stick IL cdsParam(1) vdc={vdc}
== demo/inv.shcomp
schemify 1 shcomp
  vibox -42 -32 42 22
  vsym aab279831c8cf04a
  vsch 45798dddecceda77
  vcdf d6c8dc96356fe4c9
  vcdfrec "(\"cdf\" \"\")"
  vcdfrec "(\"siminfo\" \"spectre\" ((\"termOrder\" (\"A\" \"Y\"))))"

pin A in -40 0
  vplabel 4 0 R0 centerLeft stick 6000
pin Y out 40 0
  vplabel -4 0 R0 centerRight stick 6000

impl schematic schematic

line -40 0 -20 0

poly -20 -20 15 0 -20 20
  closed true

circle 18 0 3

line 21 0 40 0

stext -20 -30 R0 {name}
  size 0.8
  vlabel instance label lowerLeft stick NLP [@instanceName] {name}
stext -20 30 R0 {cell}
  size 0.8
  vlabel device label upperLeft stick NLP [@partName] {cell}

inst bzm0kc analogLib:pmos4
  at 0 -40 R0
  name M0
  model pmos
  w 2u
  l 180n
inst yw9rth analogLib:nmos4
  at 0 40 R0
  name M1
  model nmos
  w 1u

wire 2082fx 20 40 40 40
wire 5q0ejr 40 -70 40 -40
wire 65faq1 20 -70 40 -70
wire 6ye473 -20 -40 -20 40
wire c8k666 20 -40 40 -40
wire e7w35r 20 -90 20 -70
wire hanj44 40 40 40 70
wire m9mpm5 20 0 60 0
wire necd1n 20 -10 20 10
wire v5jqqv 20 70 20 90
wire z7gf9e 20 70 40 70
wire zz835z -60 0 -20 0

label htaex2 20 -88 R270 vdd!
  voff 1 0
label peb7yn 20 90 R0 0
  vinst I2

port n1rj7r -60 0 R0 A
port y7sr15 60 0 R0 Y

text 47v4a9 -60 -120 R0 "CMOS inverter"
  size 1
  vlabel text drawing lowerLeft stick normal
== demo/tb_inv.shbench
schemify 1 shbench
  vsch 49cc1f67ba76bae0

inst 1p2r0r analogLib:vdc
  at -120 40 R0
  name V0
  vdc 1.8
inst w54bez analogLib:vdc
  at -80 40 R0
  name V1
  vdc 900m
inst zkgh4n ./inv
  at 0 0 R0
  name I0

wire 2zr01d -120 -10 -120 10
wire 9vhjhq 40 0 80 0
wire yeffrx -80 0 -80 10
wire zx3b16 -80 0 -40 0

label 7wv0vq -120 70 R0 0
  vinst I3
label 8ss5gh -80 70 R0 0
  vinst I4
label cntqnv 60 0 R0 out
  voff 0 -2
label eqzgqp -60 0 R0 in
  voff 0 -2
label th4x8q -120 -10 R0 vdd!
  voff 2 0
